note: Campaign v6 lane A, the on-theme side quests (game-research/sappers-path-v4/v6-plan.md Step 0, Peter OK 2026-10-06; tools/quest-bake.js; notes tools/campaign-v6-notes.md §4). order: the 50 campaign side quests in map order, quest i after main level gallery.quests' i-th slot (config.json: first 4, gaps 4,3,5,4, so 4..200) with tools/quests.js's prize for that slot. A kept picture names its shipped id and keeps its stored level (only n and quest change); a new one names its picture (pictures/manifest.json, lane C's outlined boards) and its tag. group: the theme group (no two neighbours share one). ladder: a quest may use a feature only when its main level (after) is at or past the feature's first level (moats 25; the lock 53, the campaign's first lock lesson, colour locks only; linked 75; ? cards 100; mystery blocks 150; no archers ever). density: per tag the most features (the moat counts) and whether it takes the lock. deck: the deck features each tag may draw from (mystery blocks only on Hard: an outlined picture inside its moat has little buried room once its face is kept clear). landConfig: merged over tools/land-config.json for the bake (LAND_CONFIG): the mystery blocks' face rule loosened for outlined cartoons (the default reads every cell beside the ink outline as face detail and leaves no room). pick: a Normal quest takes the moat first, then the unlocked deck features in turn by its count among the new quests (k mod how many); a Hard one the moat, then the newest unlocked first. amounts: linked pairs, ? cards, the share of eligible blocks hidden, and the moat's opening set (an index into land-config plan.moat.ways: 0 front and far, 1 left and right). bands: the random-tap win-rate band per tag, by the main level the quest follows ([from, [lo, hi]], the last that applies). pace: real pace range and aim (ms), the castle Gallery's. seedBase: a new picture's bake number is seedBase + its cq number (stable whatever its place). threads: the bake's worker threads. v5Places: the v5.4 Gallery's 72 ids in their places (the SP1 save code encodes pictures by place; lane B's SP1 decode needs this list).
